title: cyanus variegatus
intro: Cyanus variegatus, commonly known as Cornflower, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the daisy family. The health benefits of Cornflower include its use as an anti-inflammatory agent, which may help to reduce swelling and alleviate symptoms associated with various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Cornflower are attributed to its calming effects, which may help to soothe anxiety and promote relaxation. Cornflower contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
